visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved square crop has one clear squat dome on a narrow band, centered with empty paper above, left and below for later attachments. The thick slightly uneven felt-tip contour is easy to copy.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I compared all five saved square crops in order. The dome, base band, top button, inner shine stroke, U clamp, right screw, left lever and two sound ticks retain their anchors through the coral, teal and yellow finish. No temporary guides or unexplained erasures appear.

transitions.observed_addition: A small cylindrical button lands at the dome apex and one short curved shine stroke appears inside its upper-left face; the original dome and band remain.
transitions.instruction_match: The saved second crop matches the cap-and-shine instruction at the specified locations.

transitions.observed_addition: A U-shaped clamp hangs from the band underside and one screw circle with a diagonal slot appears on its right; the dome, band, button and shine remain.
transitions.instruction_match: The saved third crop matches the U clamp and outer screw instruction.

transitions.observed_addition: A bent lever attaches at the left end of the band and ends in a round knob; exactly two separate ringing arcs appear above-left, with the clamp and screw unchanged.
transitions.instruction_match: The saved fourth crop matches the left lever and two ringing marks instruction without shifting earlier parts.

transitions.observed_addition: Uneven coral fills the dome around the inner shine stroke; teal fills band and clamp, yellow fills button and lever. All black contours, screw, and exactly two sound marks persist.
transitions.instruction_match: The saved finish matches the named color regions and preserves every preexisting contour.
